_comment: Ruins Research Center. A boss who does no work, a staff that does all of it.
0: BRAVO!\rA young archaeologist just\nwalked into my Research Center!\fFINALLY! Fresh blood! Cheap labor!\r
1: What? You just visitin'?\nOh. Aight...\fYou got me hype for NOTHIN'.
2: My staff here is TOP tier. The research\ngo great with ZERO effort from me.\rI'm the boss. I mostly nap.\nGot questions? Ask my staff.
3: We cracked the UNOWN mystery thanks to\nYOU! I'm takin' all the credit, but\fgood looks, fr.
4: The ruins is like 1,500 years old.\nThat's all we know.\rNobody know who built 'em. My theory?\nAliens. Rich aliens.
5: Sheesh, you caught a UNOWN?!\rNow that I think about it, why we all\nof a sudden seein' UNOWN?\fIs it the 5G? It's the 5G.
6:
You gotta hear this!
This a BIG discovery!You solved the stone-panel puzzle
that made UNOWN show up.Them tablets is the key to wakin'
up the UNOWN!Still... Why would anybody make
a key like that?
7:
You gotta hear this!
This a BIG discovery!Turn on the radio in the ruins
and you pick up weird radio waves!That's proof UNOWN talk to each
other usin' radio waves!
8:
You gotta hear this!
This a BIG discovery!There's as many UNOWN as there is
letters in the alphabet!We confirmed 26 kinds.
Why don't you catch 'em all?
9: How you like the UNOWN Report\nI gave you?\rIt log UNOWN as you catch 'em.\nPretty useful!
10: You gotta hear this!\nThis a BIG discovery!\rWe figured out UNOWN go in a\ncertain order!\fLemme see your report.\r
11: There!\nI put the UNOWN in the right order!\fMaybe we learn more about 'em now.\r
12: What?\nYou found a room with UNOWN symbols?\fThat's a BIG discovery!\rWe on it right now.\r
13: You gotta hear this!\nThis a BIG discovery!\rWe found two new UNOWN symbols!\rThat mean...\nThere's two more kinds of UNOWN\fout there somewhere...\r
14:
You gotta hear this!
We learnin' more and more about the symbols on the floor!...Looks like UNOWN used to live at
the ruins with a human clan.We think that clan made the
homie statues underground.The UNOWN was real jumpy and
wouldn't go outside.When more and more people started
showin' up around the ruins, the clan that wanted peace with the UNOWN ended up leavin'...Thanks to our research and your
help, we cracked a lotta their mystery!Still a whole lot we don't know,
of course.Archaeology never end.
